# koinon

Fleet-common Rust scaffolding for forkwright crates.

## Purpose

Eliminates repeated boilerplate across all forkwright Rust repos:
tracing subscriber init, typed error types, figment config loading,
clap global arg prelude.

## Key files

- `src/lib.rs` — module declarations, crate-level docs
- `src/telemetry.rs` — tracing subscriber init (`init`, `init_compact`, `init_json`, `build_filter`)
- `src/error.rs` — `AppError`, `ConfigError`, snafu re-exports
- `src/config.rs` — figment loader (`load`, `load_with_defaults`, `load_from_env`, `load_from_env_path`)
- `src/cli.rs` — clap prelude (`GlobalArgs`, `Verbosity`)
- `ADOPTION.md` — migration guide for existing forkwright repos; its "Fleet
  migration status" table is derived, not hand-written — see `adoption/README.md`
- `adoption/` — the Python tool that derives that table (`koinon-adoption
  derive` / `check`); `adoption/registry.toml` is the tracked-repo list

## Conventions

- Cargo features: `telemetry`, `config`, `cli` (default all on; `cli` implies `telemetry`; `error` always compiled)
- All public items documented
- No `unwrap`/`expect` in library code
- `snafu` for error types; never `anyhow` or `thiserror`
- `figment` for config; never raw `serde_json::from_str` for config files
